exclusion_rule: gain comparisons are counted only where the reference LIF has no sub-grid structure: the local (0.15 mV) mean gain must agree with the secant over half the x-grid spacing; where it does not (quantised-ISI regime, x*dt/tau_m not small), the smooth transfer is a coarse-graining by design, the secant is compared instead (15 %), and local-gain comparisons are reported but not counted
